jlpt_n3_grammar_by_topic.description: Explaining reasons, proportional developments, and evolving states.

grammar_points.example_jp: お酒を飲みすぎたせいで頭が痛い。
grammar_points.example_en: My head hurts because I drank too much alcohol.

grammar_points.example_en: My Japanese improved thanks to games.

grammar_points.example_en: I became interested in Japan starting from my trip to Kyoto.

grammar_points.example_en: The more you study, the better your grades become.

grammar_points.meaning: Because of; as a result of

grammar_points.example_en: Gasoline prices just keep going up.

grammar_points.example_en: I worried a lot, but in the end, I didn't buy it.

grammar_points.example_en: I knew they were brothers from the fact their voices were similar.

grammar_points.example_jp: 雪が降った。そのために電車が遅れた。
grammar_points.example_en: It snowed. Because of that, the train was late.

jlpt_n3_grammar_by_topic.description: Directing behavior, giving suggestions, and expressing requirements.

grammar_points.example_en: You should not say such a terrible thing.

grammar_points.example_en: Ensure that you are absolutely not late tomorrow.

grammar_points.example_en: When absent, you must contact us.

grammar_points.example_jp: 早く帰らないと。
grammar_points.example_en: I must return home early.

jlpt_n3_grammar_by_topic.description: Marking specific moments, durations, and chronological order.

grammar_points.example_jp: 契約するにあたってサインをした。
grammar_points.example_en: I signed upon entering into the contract.

grammar_points.example_jp: 学校へ行く途中で雨が降ってきた。
grammar_points.example_en: It started raining on the way to school.

grammar_points.example_en: While taking a walk, I mailed the letter.

grammar_points.example_jp: 二人きりで話したい。
grammar_points.example_en: I want to talk just between the two of us.

grammar_points.example_jp: 内容を確かめた上で、サインしてください。
grammar_points.example_en: Please sign after confirming the content.

jlpt_n3_grammar_by_topic.description: Expressing convictions, limitations, and nuances of belief.
